name: 料理の材料に対応する商品と代替を確認する
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE Japanese Lighthouse recipe-ingredient-to-product matching component LH19-0010, compact portrait on pure white canvas, complete readable3 rows.
HIERARCHY: image1 ORIGINAL Cherrypick source highest authority for swap glyph geometry (two curved opposing arrows), checkmark box shape, dropdown chevron, +/- proportions, states, spacing and fine detail. Image2 Japanese mock SECONDARY text/layout; correct missing/rough substitute controls using original, do not reproduce crude straight swap arrows or V dropdown. Images3/4 protected original cream/chilli product photographs: preserve packaging, wordmarks, actual crop/colors. Image5 approved Lighthouse style only: white rounded card, fine neutral divisions, restrained shadow/green selection; no bus content.
Header row: neutral circular minus control, number 「2」, neutral circular plus control, compact bold 「標準 2人分」. Note exactly 「未選択の食材は健康スコアに含まれません。」 in metadata.
Three ingredient/product sections, separated by fine neutral lines:
1) ORIGINAL pale-gray placeholder artwork (watermelon wedge and pear silhouettes as shown in image1; do not replace with chicken photo). Label 「鶏むね肉の角切り 375 g」. Supporting product 「英国産の鶏むね肉角切り 750 g ×1」 is STRUCK THROUGH as ORIGINAL unavailable product. Right quiet slate swap icon and 「変更」. Unavailable status 「現在入荷していません」. Source shows a selected check box for unavailable row; preserve its explicit check state with forest-green gradient square and white tick. Do not invent stock or safety.
2) ORIGINAL cream package photo, label 「ダブルクリーム 75 ml」; metadata 「ダブルクリーム 150 ml ×1」; right source curved swap icon + 「変更」. Below quantity 「1」 with accurate down chevron and CHECKED selection box, as source. Green selected check, white other controls.
3) ORIGINAL chilli package photo, copy 「青唐辛子 ½本・みじん切り」「辛い味が好みなら種を残す」; metadata 「青唐辛子 65 g ×1」; small leaf symbol and 「植物由来」 source category, green outline/text with white background (no broad mint badge). Right curved swap icon + 「変更」. Source cuts off before chilli quantity/checkbox, so OMIT mock's unverified quantity1/empty checkbox rather than invent this state.
No prices (authorized Japanese adaptation), no unshown alternatives, dialogs, title/nav, invented score or stock values. Preserve required amount versus package unit separation. Locked Meiryo body Regular14/24, metadata12/16, tracking0; bold only established compact header. Main ink #1D1D1D, secondary #6E6E6E, utility glyphs #526173. Forest gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E on selected check controls; original magenta utilities become slate, plant semantic green remains subordinate. White page/card, modest rounded boundary, soft elevation; original artwork colors retained, all labels visible, no clipping/gloss.
reviewNotes: 原本・3派生画像・日本語モック・独立編集を実見。原本優先で曲線の交換矢印、下向きシェブロン、鶏肉の取り消し線と選択済みチェックを復元。未入荷、必要量と包装単位、標準2人分、健康スコア注記、植物由来表示を確認。原本で見切れる唐辛子の数量／選択は補完せず。通常操作はスレート、選択は森林色、植物由来の意味色と商品絵柄を保持。日本語の欠け・切れなし。画素／フォント寸法厳密比較、実在庫、所有者承認、編集可能性、アプリ動作は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
